items.title: 0.4.7 is out
items.text: The biggest Reborn update yet is out for everyone, and you are already on it. Stats, leaderboards and achievements, clan tags, a protected name, fairer teams, a bug report form, new controls and prompts, Discord status and a much lighter game.

items.title: Your service record
items.text: Kills, flags, headshots, repairs, time in every kit and vehicle and more, counted by the Reborn servers.

items.title: Leaderboards are back
items.text: Score, Kills, K/D, Flags and Time, for all time, this month and this week, with your own row pinned.

items.title: 12 achievements, plus 3 new
items.text: All 12 of the game's, and 3 new Reborn ones, with a popup and a chime when you unlock one.

items.title: Wear your [TAG]
items.text: 2 to 4 letters or digits before your name, set on your name page with RB or F4.

items.title: Protect your name
items.text: Keep your name, rank and stats with a recovery code. No email and no password, and you can paste the code.

items.title: Even teams, no penalty
items.text: Lopsided teams are evened out on Reborn servers, one player at a time, with no points lost.

items.title: Report bugs from the game
items.text: A three step form on the main menu. You see everything that is sent, and no GitHub account is needed.

items.title: Controls by device
items.text: Pick keyboard and mouse or controller, in Settings and at the first start, and see only what is for it.

items.title: New prompts, original sounds
items.text: Kenney's button prompts for every pad and the keyboard, and the original menus' sounds from your game files.

items.title: Your match on Discord
items.text: Your Discord profile shows the map, team, server and match time. Never an address or another name.

items.title: Smoother and lighter
items.text: Much less memory, better frame rates on older PCs, a faster start, a smaller download and no audio crackling.

items.title: Runs on more Linux
items.text: The AppImage now starts on Ubuntu 22.04, Linux Mint 21, Debian 12 and newer, with Wayland at full size.

items.title: Steadier servers
items.text: Clear messages for full servers and maintenance, and fewer server crashes.

items.title: Built with the community
items.text: Thank you to everyone who played and reported, and to DiXN, Erubadhron, ThatZaliaSGuy and Kenney.

items.title: Join us on Discord
items.text: Find a squad, see when the servers fill up and tell us what you find in the playtest.
